templateCode.flowchart:
flowchart TD
  A[Start] --> B{Condition?}
  B -- yes --> C[Action]
  B -- no --> D[Other]
  C --> E[End]
  D --> E
templateCode.sequence:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Client
  participant S as Server
  A->>S: Request
  S-->>A: Response
  Note over A,S: exchange complete
templateCode.class:
classDiagram
  class Page {
    +string id
    +string title
    +render()
  }
  class Space
  Space "1" --> "*" Page
templateCode.state:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Published: publish
  Published --> Archived: archive
  Archived --> [*]
templateCode.er:
erDiagram
  SPACE ||--o{ PAGE : contains
  PAGE ||--o{ ASSET : embeds
  PAGE {
    string id
    string title
  }
